mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as long as the rate remains at or below this threshold.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for two consecutive months signals persistent labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST below 580.0) and consumer spending (RSAFS below 340,000) indicate broad demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST < 580.0 and RSAFS < 340000 does not produce negative 20-day returns in at least 60% of cases (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (2017 base) signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansion regimes defined by high interest rates and low unemployment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% AND UNRATE < 5.0%) holds (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 8.0% consistently indicates labor market slack that suppresses consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction below 550.0 thousand units signals housing market collapse that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 550.0 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPI index above 210 and federal funds rate above 0.5% signal monetary tightening that raises equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (CPIAUCSL > 210 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) does not produce negative 60-day returns in at least 60% of cases (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending above 350,000 million dollars signals robust economic growth that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 350000 (p-value > 0.05 in t-test against zero).
